name: Explosión
description: You release an enormous explosion in a {shape}, fainting immediately before the damage is dealt. Creatures in the area must make a {save}. A creature takes {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. If you have less than half your hit points left, then the damage is halved.

updated.details: Overhauled into a damaging emanation, similar to Self-Destruct.
